records.summary_text:
[CW note] From the CryptoWeeklies video of 26 October 2026.

[2026-10-26_SOL]  
Video Title: App Demo: Solana $SOL Accumulation Analysis  
Video ID: Hd8kEW-ZUqE  
Solana (SOL) | Class: CRYPTO  

Current Structure  
The live price sits at $103, a 16% premium over its lifetime weighted average price of $87. The 20‑week simple moving average is trending downward, indicating a mild pullback in momentum, yet the composite risk score remains in the lower quartile, placing SOL in the breakout section alongside assets that have rallied 38% over the past 90 days (down 15% in the last 30 days, -2.7% in the last 7 days, and flat over 24 h). Social sentiment word‑cloud analysis shows a surge in bullish terms, reinforcing the asset’s accumulation phase.  

Macro Quantitative Risk  
The TWAP baseline is $87; the current price is 16% above this level, triggering a risk‑level signal when the lifetime weighted average price risk exceeds 80. Risk levels 6–7 are flagged as “warmer” zones, while anything below risk level 2 is considered low risk. Regression‑based fair‑value bands place SOL at 28% overvalued relative to the polynomial regression model, whereas historically it is typically 22% undervalued, suggesting a residual overvaluation zone. The 10‑week bull case and a 2040 scenario project a cumulative upside if the asset remains in an accumulation phase.  

Downside & Upside Targets  
Machine‑learning forecast models project a cycle bull target near the 10‑week high, with a panic‑drawdown floor around −10% and a non‑panic floor near −5%. Macro moving‑average supports include the 20‑week SMA and the lifetime weighted average price; a break below either would trigger a re‑evaluation of the upside. The asset ranks 8 out of 100 in the top‑40 crypto cohort, with a median percentile of 95%, indicating strong relative positioning. Comparative analysis shows Bitcoin at 166% rally versus 16% for SOL, and the platform’s alerts trigger when fear‑and‑greed crosses 60–70, providing a clear trigger for potential reversal points.
